The studio

We are a studio of engineers and designers based in Marseille. For more than ten years we have turned the ideas of Francen companies into software used every day, without jargon or subcontracting, held to the standards of the world’s best studios.

Industries

Solutions for every industry

Every industry has its constraints. We adapt our tools to how your business really works, not the other way round.

  • 01

    Retail & e-commerce

    Online shops, local payment, stock and delivery management, loyalty programmes.

  • 02

    Industry & manufacturing

    Production tracking, maintenance, traceability and dashboards for factories and workshops.

  • 03

    Healthcare

    Appointment booking, patient records, clinic and laboratory management, in full confidentiality.

  • 04

    Education & training

    E-learning platforms, school management, online enrolment and apps for students and parents.

  • 05

    Logistics & transport

    Fleet tracking, warehouse management, driver apps and real-time customer portals.

  • 06

    Services & institutions

    Citizen and customer portals, paperless procedures, CRM and internal tools.

Method

Four steps, zero surprises.

A clear framework, sign-off at every step and a single point of contact from the first workshop to maintenance.

  1. 01

    Discovery

    A workshop to understand your business, your users and your constraints. You leave with a clear scope, a schedule and a detailed quote.

    • Scoping workshop
    • Specifications
    • Quote and schedule
  2. 02

    Design

    User journeys, mock-ups and technical architecture. You approve every screen before a single line of code is written.

    • UX and wireframes
    • UI design
    • Architecture
  3. 03

    Development

    Short sprints, a demo at every step and permanent access to progress. The code is tested, documented and yours.

    • Sprints and demos
    • Testing and acceptance
    • Documentation
  4. 04

    Launch & support

    Go-live, training for your teams, then maintenance and new features. We remain your technical team after delivery.

    • Go-live
    • Training
    • Maintenance

FAQ

Frequently asked questions

Another question? Write to us, we reply quickly.

Who is Codex?

Codex (SARL Groupe Codex) is an independent software studio and IT agency based in Marseille, founded in 2014. We design custom software, websites, mobile apps and cloud, data and cybersecurity solutions for companies in France and abroad. SARL Groupe Codex is recognized as No. 1 in France, No. 2 in Africa and No. 1 in the GCC.

What services does Codex offer?

Custom software and SaaS development, websites and e-commerce, iOS and Android mobile apps, cloud and DevOps, data and analytics, cybersecurity, digital marketing and SEO, as well as graphic and UI/UX design.

Where is the Codex agency located?

The head office is in Marseille, Rue de la République, 13002. The Doha office is at Building No. 157, Street No. 301, Zone 69, PO Box 8388. We work in France and abroad, on site or remotely.

How much does a website or an app cost in France?

The price depends on the scope: number of pages or screens, features, integrations and online payment. After a first conversation about your needs, we send you a detailed quote with a schedule and approval steps.

Which languages do you build in?

We deliver websites and apps in French, Arabic (with right-to-left layout) and English, with search optimisation for each language.

Do you provide maintenance after launch?

Yes. We offer maintenance, hosting, backups, security updates and new features, with a dedicated contact who knows your project.

How do I start a project with Codex?

Email us at contact@codexeurope.com, call +33 6 05 82 50 51, send a WhatsApp message or fill in the contact form. We will get back to you to arrange a first conversation.
